name: Digital Nerve Injury
definition: Traumatic injury of a proper or common digital nerve causing focal sensory loss, dysesthesia or painful neuroma.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; ultrasound can assist in selected cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Early hand-surgery assessment for complete laceration
amber: Primary microsurgical repair is considered for transected nerves.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli/Vata nerve-injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic injury of a proper or common digital nerve causing focal sensory loss, dysesthesia or painful neuroma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
